title: Stock Analysts’ Updated EPS Estimates for September, 27th (AAPL, AGQ, AIR, ALPN, AMZN, BBBY, BON, BPC, CLIN, CLON)
text:
Stock Analysts’ updated eps estimates for Thursday, September 27th:
JPMorgan Chase & Co. began coverage on shares of Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) . JPMorgan Chase & Co. issued a buy rating and a $272.00 target price on the stock. Get Apple Inc alerts:

BTIG Research began coverage on shares of Frontline (NYSE:FRO) . They issued a neutral rating on the stock.
Hawaiian (NASDAQ:HA) had its outperform rating reissued by analysts at Imperial Capital. The firm currently has a $77.00 target price on the stock.
Hologic (NASDAQ:HOLX) had its buy rating reiterated by analysts at Needham & Company LLC. Needham & Company LLC currently has a $48.00 target price on the stock. The analysts wrote, “HOLX is acquiring Focal Therapeutics (private) for $125M in cash. HOLX expects the acquisition to close in and be neutral to HOLX’s FY19 adjusted EPS. Focal Therapeutics’s BioZorb implant advances post- operation tumor removal area identification. We view this transaction as an affordable way to strengthen HOLX’s Breast Health business and it appears to be complementary to HOLX’s recent Faxitron acquisition. We reiterate our Buy rating.””
